info.title: API.SH: Avito
info.description: The Avito API from API.SH: public Avito data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Avito's category tree: each top category (transport, real estate, jobs, services, electronics, home, hobbies, animals, business...) with its subcategories, each with the site's category id, name, slug (use it as `category` in /avito/v1/search) and link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 5 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/avito-categories

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Avito listing in full: title, price in rubles and whether it was lowered, full description (plain text and the site's HTML), category with breadcrumbs, every parameter the seller filled in (brand, model, memory, mileage, area...), address, city, coordinates, all photos, publication text, expiry date, total and today's views, delivery and reservation flags, closed status, contact methods offered, and the seller's type, rating, review count, listing count, reply time and time on Avito. The seller's display name and profile link as the site shows them; a company seller also has its logo. Phone numbers are not returned. `raw` keeps the listing record as the site returns it. A removed or unknown listing answers 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 5 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/avito-listing

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: Instead of url or id: return the first current listing of the search given by the /avito/v1/search parameters on this call (location, category, q, ...); without q or category, phones in the given location (default moskva).

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: With latest: the search's region or city.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: With latest: the search's category path.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Listings on Avito (avito.ru), Russia's largest classifieds site, for a region or city and a category, with every filter the site offers: keywords, price range, seller type (private or company), condition, Avito Delivery only, with photos only, titles only, radius, sort, and any category parameter (brand, model, memory, mileage, rooms...) as `params[<id>]=<value>`. The ids and values for the category come back in `filters`. Each listing has id, link, title, price in rubles (with old price and discount when reduced), short description, key parameters, category, city, address and nearest metro stations, coordinates, publication time, photos, delivery and reservation flags, badges, and the seller's type, rating and review count. The seller's display name and profile link as the site shows them; a company seller also has its logo. `total` is the number of matching listings. 50 listings per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page (the site shows up to 100 pages). `url` accepts any avito.ru search link instead of `location` and `category`. Give at least `q`, `category` or `url`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 5 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/avito-search

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Region or city as in Avito links (rossiya for all of Russia, moskva, sankt-peterburg, moskovskaya_oblast, ekaterinburg, kazan...). A Russian name (самара, Нижний Новгород) works too. Default rossiya.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category path as in Avito links (telefony, noutbuki, avtomobili, kvartiry/prodam...). Slugs are listed by /avito/v1/categories. Service sub-categories exist only as Avito links with a code (.../potolki-ASgB...): pass those as url.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An avito.ru search or category link (used instead of location and category; its own filters are kept).

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: New or used items (for categories that have a condition filter, such as phones, laptops, cars).

parameters.name: titles_only
parameters.description: Match the keywords in titles only.

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: Search radius around the city in km (0-1000).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A seller's public Avito profile (businesses and private sellers): name, logo, time on Avito, subscribers, verification and delivery badges, rating with the count for each star, review count, listing count, about text, delivery and payment terms, store addresses with coordinates, nearest metro and opening hours, the latest 25 reviews (author as shown, role, stars, date, item, deal stage, text, photos, the business's answer), and the seller's listings (15 per page). The profile, reviews and address come with page 1; later pages carry the next listings. Pass `next_page` back as `page` for more listings; null on the last page. Pass a profile link (avito.ru/brands/... or avito.ru/user/.../profile, as `profile_url` in search and listing answers). Private sellers come with their display name, rating, reviews and listings; no addresses, and phone numbers in their about text are hidden.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 5 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/avito-seller

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The profile name from the link, e.g. takesmart (instead of url).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
